_comment: Orkeon Code on Claude, through the API credits of a Max plan. Since October 2026 a Max plan includes monthly API credits (100 USD on Max 5x, 200 USD on Max 20x, no rollover), spent through an API key of the Anthropic Console organisation linked to the plan: on claude.ai, Settings, Billing, API credits, Link organization (the link is made once, only the support changes it), then create a key in that organisation. The key goes in the environment, export ANTHROPIC_API_KEY=..., never in this file; beyond the credits the key is billed at the API's usage rates. Signing in with the plan itself is reserved to Anthropic's own applications, so it is not a way to run Orkeon Code. Copy this file to config/appsettings.local.json (ignored by git), or pass it with --settings. Orkeon recognises Anthropic by its address, requests its prompt cache with cache_control and reads the tokens it served, so /usage and /context show cacheRead and cacheWrite. No Temperature: the current Claude generation refuses one, and Orkeon sends only what the file sets. The AvailableModels are the other Claude models /model switches to: claude-fable-5-1 is the most capable and costs about two and a half times claude-opus-5-5 per token, so it empties the monthly credits faster, and it needs an organisation with the standard 30-day data retention (one under zero data retention gets a 400). /effort sets the thinking effort. The other sections are those of config/appsettings.example.json; every key is explained in docs/configuration.md.
